narration: Everyone says get on a budget. But researchers just found traditional budgets make most people spend more, not less. Here's what they're not telling you.
visual: A budget paper with neat category rows (FOOD $400, GAS $200, FUN $150, CLOTHES $100) slides up while a shocked person silhouette with wide eyes appears beside it on a dark background

narration: Write '$400 for food' and your brain hears permission to spend $400. Studies show budgeted categories get spent 20% over limit — every single time.
visual: Fork-and-knife restaurant icon on light background, a progress bar fills from $0 to $400 (green) then overshoots to $480 (turns red), PERMISSION GRANTED stamp appears

narration: And 80% of people quit tracking entirely within three months. Not because they're bad with money — just because counting every dollar is exhausting.
visual: Three calendar month boxes appear one by one: Month 1 in green (ON TRACK), Month 2 in yellow (SLIPPING), Month 3 with a red X (ABANDONED)

narration: Even after you quit, you're still spending $3,360 more per year than if you'd never budgeted. The guilt cycle is real — and it costs.
visual: Three animated bar chart columns — BEFORE ($2,800/mo, green), DURING BUDGET ($3,360/mo, yellow), AFTER QUITTING ($3,080/mo, red) — growing in height with annotation showing $3,360 per year extra

narration: Here's what actually works — reverse budgeting. Move savings automatically on payday, then spend the rest guilt-free. No categories, no tracking needed.
visual: Flow diagram on dark background: PAYCHECK circle with dollar sign, red arrow labeled FIRST pointing to piggy bank (coin falling into slot), green arrow labeled REST pointing to smiling stick person

narration: People who switch to reverse budgeting save 34% more without tracking a single dollar. Follow for the money strategies that actually work.
visual: Five growing bar chart columns (Year 1 through Year 5) in red showing compounding extra savings growth to $16,800, ending with a CTA button FOLLOW FOR MONEY TRUTHS THAT WORK
